transcript: Stand on coarse salt for 10 minutes and watch what happens to your body. Spread a thick layer of salt on the floor, take off your shoes and stand on it barefoot. Stay still. Salt is the most powerful conductor nature ever created. Your feet have more than 7,000 nerve endings connected to every organ in your body. When you stand on salt, those endings activate and something starts to shift. Your cortisol drops, inflammation fades, your muscles release tension you didn't even know you were holding. Your mood changes, your mind clears and that night your sleep feels different. In the oldest tradition salt has been used for centuries to cleanse and balance energy. It's no coincidence that after a swim in the ocean you feel different. Salt absorbs what's left over, everything your body collected throughout the day. Tension, stress, energetic load, salt draws it out. Do it every night before bed, 10 minutes barefoot on the salt in silence. No phone, no noise, no one, just you and the salt afterwards sweep the salt up and throw it away. It already absorbed what it needed to absorb, don't reuse it. Many people notice that from the very first night they sleep more deeply, that they wake up feeling lighter and their mind is clearer. Save this video, but I want you to understand something. Salt absorbs what you accumulated today. But if tomorrow you go back to living just as stressed, you accumulate the same thing. Salt cleanses from the outside. The real change is learning not to accumulate in the first place, to release tension before it settles in, to live without stress filling you up every single day. And if you want to learn how to let go of what you carry so your body stops holding it, I have spent over 20 years quietly learning how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the road back to calm. The link is in my profile.
